original_text:
🎓 Salaried PhD opportunity at Chalmers University of Technology | Sweden

PhD Position: AI-Based Groundwater Modelling and Decision Support

Chalmers University of Technology is inviting applications for a PhD position in the following area:

🔬 Research focus
Groundwater modelling, artificial intelligence, geospatial data, hydrogeology, uncertainty, and decision support

🎯 Project objective
To combine numerical models, geospatial data, and machine learning for improved groundwater-management decisions.

📌 Key details
• Country: Sweden
• Position type: Salaried employment
• Deadline: 7 August 2026
• Expected start: By agreement
• Supervisors: Engineering Geology research team at Chalmers

✅ Suitable backgrounds
Water engineering, civil engineering, environmental engineering, hydrogeology, geomatics, geoscience, AI, and data science

🛠 Key skills
Groundwater modelling, GIS, Python/R/MATLAB, machine learning, uncertainty analysis, value-of-information methods, and decision support

Interested candidates should review the full call carefully and prepare their application materials well before the deadline.

🔗 Application / official link

https://t.co/kd1AkWf04A
Please share this opportunity with qualified candidates in your network.

#PhD #AcademicOpportunities #AI #DataScience #WaterResources
